activity_summary: Back at the lodging, this morning's penny loaf lay on the bread-board, a full thumb short of the notch. Mistress Ansell had left it there on purpose. The price was still a penny. You did not move it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the loaf she had left out, and did not cut it.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in A thumb short of the notch

facets.activity: Looked at the loaf a thumb short of the notch
